correct_answer: Do not close — Section 14.1 requires cure against the cited standard (v8.1), Gregory's resolved comment confirms this interpretation, and the #0189 precedent was informal with no policy memo
rationale: The franchise agreement's Section 14.1 explicitly states cure periods are measured against standards cited in the Notice of Default — here, v8.1 Section 4.3 requiring 40 sq ft. Gregory Park's resolved Google Doc comment (hidden by default in the document) confirms legal's position that v9 changes do not retroactively resolve defaults issued under v8.1. Answer D misapplies Section 11.2 ('as amended from time to time') — that governs ongoing compliance obligations, not active cure periods which are governed by the more specific Section 14.1. Answer B relies on the #0189 precedent, but that was an informal decision by a single attorney with no policy memo, found only in a buried email forward — it does not constitute binding organizational policy and Gregory's own documented position contradicts it. Answer D misreads silence in a Slack thread as a decision; the thread simply wasn't resolved yet, and 'no action required' ignores the franchisee's active compliance question that needs a formal response before the cure deadline.
